# Upstream repos (`owner/name`, one per line) whose
# GitHub artifact attestations are REQUIRED by the auto-
# update workflow. Recipes whose `[source].repo` matches
# an entry here get status=tampered when
# `gh attestation verify` returns "no attestations found"
# — i.e. we assume attestation coverage won't regress.
#
# Leave empty until an upstream is known to publish
# attestations via `actions/attest-build-provenance`.
# Adding a repo is a one-way promotion: the recipe will
# stop auto-updating if attestations disappear.
#
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored
# (grep -Fx match against this file requires a bare
# owner/name, so comment markers above never collide).
